question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt this `channels.msteams.accounts` and `defaultAccount` public contract, with legacy root config as the implicit default account and account-scoped auth/session/proactive-send state?
rationale: The remaining question is permanent Teams API and upgrade policy; source review and green checks can validate the implementation, but they cannot choose the product contract for Teams operators.

options.title: Accept current contract
options.body: Treat the account map, default-account compatibility, per-account listener model, and scoped state/auth behavior as the supported Teams multi-account API.

options.title: Request contract revisions
options.body: Ask for targeted schema, listener, migration, or credential-resolution changes before merging if this is not the desired Teams API.

options.title: Pause for broader account design
options.body: Keep the feature issue open and pause this PR if Teams multi-account support should wait for a cross-channel account or shared-listener design.

recommendation.title: Accept current contract
recommendation.body: Treat the account map, default-account compatibility, per-account listener model, and scoped state/auth behavior as the supported Teams multi-account API.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux is the requested Microsoft/Teams reviewer in the PR discussion and owns the Microsoft tracker context around this work.
